final: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) as underage_patients_1990_1993 FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 18 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
